#!/usr/bin/env python3
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
EXPECTED = "c1ec1915fc16f3dc1ec5d47d9a97f6210a574526"


def run(*args: str, cwd: Path | None = None, env: dict[str, str] | None = None) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]:
    return subprocess.run(args, cwd=cwd, env=env, text=True, capture_output=True)


def must(proc: subprocess.CompletedProcess[str], label: str) -> str:
    assert proc.returncode == 0, f"{label} failed\nstdout={proc.stdout}\nstderr={proc.stderr}"
    return proc.stdout.strip()


def test_fixture_acquisition() -> None:
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="t3-acq-") as tmp:
        tmp_path = Path(tmp)
        remote = tmp_path / "remote.git"
        work = tmp_path / "work"
        clone = tmp_path / "clone"
        restored = tmp_path / "restored"
        bundle = tmp_path / "source.bundle"
        workspace = tmp_path / "workspace"
        (workspace / "source" / "staging").mkdir(parents=True)
        (workspace / "source" / "primary").mkdir(parents=True)
        (workspace / "scripts").mkdir()
        shutil.copy2(ROOT / "scripts" / "ingest_source.py", workspace / "scripts" / "ingest_source.py")

        must(run("git", "init", "--bare", str(remote)), "bare init")
        must(run("git", "init", str(work)), "work init")
        must(run("git", "config", "user.email", "fixture@example.invalid", cwd=work), "email config")
        must(run("git", "config", "user.name", "Fixture", cwd=work), "name config")
        (work / "README.md").write_text("fixture\n", encoding="utf-8")
        must(run("git", "add", "README.md", cwd=work), "add")
        env = os.environ.copy()
        env.update({
            "GIT_AUTHOR_DATE": "2000-01-01T00:00:00Z",
            "GIT_COMMITTER_DATE": "2000-01-01T00:00:00Z",
        })
        must(run("git", "commit", "-m", "fixture", cwd=work, env=env), "commit")
        fixture_commit = must(run("git", "rev-parse", "HEAD", cwd=work), "rev-parse")
        must(run("git", "branch", "-M", "main", cwd=work), "branch")
        must(run("git", "remote", "add", "origin", str(remote), cwd=work), "remote add")
        must(run("git", "push", "-u", "origin", "main", cwd=work), "push")
        must(run("git", "symbolic-ref", "HEAD", "refs/heads/main", cwd=remote), "remote head")

        must(run("git", "clone", "--no-local", str(remote), str(clone)), "full clone")
        must(run("git", "-C", str(clone), "cat-file", "-e", f"{fixture_commit}^{{commit}}"), "commit verify")
        must(run("git", "-C", str(clone), "checkout", "--detach", fixture_commit), "checkout")
        must(run("git", "-C", str(clone), "fsck", "--full", "--strict"), "fsck")
        assert not must(run("git", "-C", str(clone), "status", "--porcelain"), "status")
        must(run("git", "-C", str(clone), "bundle", "create", str(bundle), "--all"), "bundle create")
        must(run("git", "-C", str(clone), "bundle", "verify", str(bundle)), "bundle verify")
        shutil.rmtree(remote)
        must(run("git", "clone", str(bundle), str(restored)), "bundle restore")
        assert must(run("git", "-C", str(restored), "rev-parse", "HEAD"), "restored head") == fixture_commit

        # Adapt the pinned commit only inside the isolated copied intake script.
        intake = workspace / "scripts" / "ingest_source.py"
        text = intake.read_text(encoding="utf-8").replace(EXPECTED, fixture_commit)
        intake.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
        proc = run("python3", str(intake), "--bundle", str(bundle), cwd=workspace)
        must(proc, "transactional intake")
        primary = workspace / "source" / "primary"
        assert must(run("git", "-C", str(primary), "rev-parse", "HEAD"), "primary head") == fixture_commit
        must(run("git", "-C", str(primary), "fsck", "--full", "--strict"), "primary fsck")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_fixture_acquisition()
    print("PASS: exact-SHA acquisition, Git integrity validation, bundle creation, transactional intake, and offline bundle reuse work against a fixture repository.")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import re
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
SCRIPTS = sorted((ROOT / "scripts").glob("*.ps1"))


def strip_ps(text: str) -> str:
    out: list[str] = []
    i = 0
    quote = None
    while i < len(text):
        ch = text[i]
        nxt = text[i + 1] if i + 1 < len(text) else ""
        if quote:
            if ch == "`" and i + 1 < len(text):
                i += 2
                continue
            if ch == quote:
                if quote == "'" and nxt == "'":
                    i += 2
                    continue
                quote = None
            i += 1
            continue
        if ch in {"'", '"'}:
            quote = ch
            i += 1
            continue
        if ch == "#":
            while i < len(text) and text[i] not in "\r\n":
                i += 1
            continue
        out.append(ch)
        i += 1
    return "".join(out)


def balanced(text: str, opener: str, closer: str) -> bool:
    depth = 0
    for ch in text:
        if ch == opener:
            depth += 1
        elif ch == closer:
            depth -= 1
            if depth < 0:
                return False
    return depth == 0


def main() -> None:
    assert SCRIPTS, "No PowerShell scripts found"
    for script in SCRIPTS:
        data = script.read_bytes()
        assert not data.startswith(b"\xef\xbb\xbf"), f"Unexpected UTF-8 BOM in {script.name}"
        text = data.decode("utf-8")
        for ch in text:
            code = ord(ch)
            assert ch in "\r\n\t" or code >= 32, f"Control character U+{code:04X} in {script.name}"
        cleaned = strip_ps(text)
        assert balanced(cleaned, "{", "}"), f"Unbalanced braces in {script.name}"
        assert balanced(cleaned, "(", ")"), f"Unbalanced parentheses in {script.name}"
        assert "$ErrorActionPreference" in text, f"Missing fail-fast policy in {script.name}"

    acquire = (ROOT / "scripts" / "acquire_source.ps1").read_text()
    for needle in [
        "git clone --no-local",
        "git bundle verify",
        "git -C $Staging fsck --full --strict",
        "git -C $Staging status --porcelain",
        "git -C $Staging bundle create",
        "ingest_source.py",
    ]:
        assert needle in acquire, f"Missing acquisition control: {needle}"

    prerequisites = (ROOT / "scripts" / "acquire_windows_prerequisites.ps1").read_text()
    for needle in [
        "node-win-x64@24.13.1",
        "pnpm@11.10.0",
        "corepack@0.35.0",
        "Assert-ArchiveHash",
        "node.expected_version",
        "Microsoft.VisualStudio.2022.BuildTools",
    ]:
        assert needle in prerequisites, f"Missing prerequisite control: {needle}"

    acquire_everything = (ROOT / "scripts" / "acquire_everything.ps1").read_text()
    for needle in [
        "validate_powershell.ps1",
        "verify_materials.py",
        "verify_workspace_manifest.py",
        "acquire_windows_prerequisites.ps1",
        "acquire_source.ps1",
        "capture_baseline.ps1",
        "refresh_workspace_manifest.py",
    ]:
        assert needle in acquire_everything, f"Missing all-in-one acquisition control: {needle}"

    baseline = (ROOT / "scripts" / "capture_baseline.ps1").read_text()
    for needle in [
        "source\\SOURCE_LOCK.json",
        "git -C $Source status --porcelain",
        "v24.13.1",
        "11.10.0",
        "pnpm install --frozen-lockfile",
        "pnpm run typecheck",
        "pnpm run lint",
        "pnpm test",
        "pnpm run build",
    ]:
        assert needle in baseline, f"Missing baseline control: {needle}"

    intake = (ROOT / "scripts" / "ingest_source.py").read_text()
    for needle in [
        "MAX_ARCHIVE_UNCOMPRESSED",
        "archive symlink is not accepted",
        "git_fsck_passed",
        "History-free source cannot prove",
        "--authoritative-no-history",
        "primary.previous",
    ]:
        assert needle in intake, f"Missing intake control: {needle}"

    print("PASS: PowerShell scripts pass control-character, structural-balance, and critical-token checks. Runtime AST parsing is enforced by validate_powershell.ps1 on Windows.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
IMPORTER = ROOT / "scripts" / "import_verified_snapshot.py"
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("snapshot_importer", IMPORTER)
assert spec and spec.loader
module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(module)


def run(args: list[str], expect_success: bool) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]:
    proc = subprocess.run(args, text=True, capture_output=True, check=False)
    if expect_success and proc.returncode != 0:
        raise AssertionError(f"expected success\nstdout={proc.stdout}\nstderr={proc.stderr}")
    if not expect_success and proc.returncode == 0:
        raise AssertionError("expected failure")
    return proc


def make_fixture(base: Path, entries: list[tuple[str, str, bytes]], *, repository: str = module.EXPECTED_REPOSITORY, commit: str = module.EXPECTED_COMMIT, add_submodule: bool = False, lfs_pointer: bool = False) -> tuple[Path, Path, str]:
    blobs_dir = base / "blobs"
    blobs_dir.mkdir(parents=True)
    manifest_entries: list[dict[str, object]] = []
    dirs: set[str] = set()
    blob_records: list[dict[str, object]] = []
    for path, mode, data in entries:
        if lfs_pointer and path.endswith("lfs.bin"):
            data = b"version https://git-lfs.github.com/spec/v1\noid sha256:" + b"0" * 64 + b"\nsize 1\n"
        sha = module.git_blob_sha(data)
        (blobs_dir / sha).write_bytes(data)
        blob_records.append({"path": path, "mode": mode, "type": "blob", "sha": sha, "size": len(data)})
        parent = Path(path).parent.as_posix()
        while parent not in {"", "."}:
            dirs.add(parent)
            parent = Path(parent).parent.as_posix()
    computed: dict[str, str] = {}
    for directory in sorted(dirs | {""}, key=lambda item: (item.count("/"), item), reverse=True):
        children: list[tuple[str, str, str]] = []
        prefix = f"{directory}/" if directory else ""
        for record in blob_records:
            if Path(record["path"]).parent.as_posix() == (directory or "."):
                children.append((record["mode"], Path(record["path"]).name, record["sha"]))
        for child in dirs:
            if Path(child).parent.as_posix() == (directory or "."):
                children.append(("40000", Path(child).name, computed[child]))
        computed[directory] = module.git_tree_sha(children)
    for directory in sorted(dirs):
        manifest_entries.append({"path": directory, "mode": "040000", "type": "tree", "sha": computed[directory]})
    manifest_entries.extend(blob_records)
    if add_submodule:
        manifest_entries.append({"path": "vendor/submodule", "mode": "160000", "type": "commit", "sha": "1" * 40})
    manifest = {
        "schemaVersion": 2,
        "repository": repository,
        "commit": commit,
        "tree": computed[""],
        "parents": ["2" * 40],
        "message": "fixture",
        "author": {"name": "Fixture", "email": "fixture@example.invalid", "date": "2000-01-01T00:00:00Z"},
        "committer": {"name": "Fixture", "email": "fixture@example.invalid", "date": "2000-01-01T00:00:00Z"},
        "treeTruncated": False,
        "entries": manifest_entries,
    }
    manifest_path = base / "snapshot-manifest.json"
    manifest_path.write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    return manifest_path, blobs_dir, computed[""]


def importer_args(base: Path, manifest: Path, blobs: Path) -> list[str]:
    return [
        sys.executable, str(IMPORTER),
        "--manifest", str(manifest),
        "--blobs-dir", str(blobs),
        "--upstream-output", str(base / "out" / "upstream"),
        "--primary-output", str(base / "out" / "primary"),
        "--source-lock", str(base / "out" / "SOURCE_LOCK.json"),
        "--source-manifest", str(base / "out" / "SOURCE_MANIFEST.json"),
    ]


def test_success() -> None:
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        base = Path(tmp)
        manifest, blobs, root_sha = make_fixture(base, [
            ("README.md", "100644", b"fixture\n"),
            ("bin/run.sh", "100755", b"#!/bin/sh\nexit 0\n"),
            ("links/readme", "120000", b"../README.md"),
        ])
        run(importer_args(base, manifest, blobs), True)
        lock = json.loads((base / "out" / "SOURCE_LOCK.json").read_text())
        assert lock["verifiedUpstreamTree"] == root_sha
        assert lock["allBlobHashesVerified"] is True
        assert lock["snapshotTreeFullyEnumerated"] is True
        assert lock["originalGitDatabaseAvailable"] is False
        primary = base / "out" / "primary"
        assert subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(primary), "fsck", "--full", "--strict"]).returncode == 0
        assert subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(primary), "status", "--porcelain"], text=True) == ""
        assert subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(primary), "rev-parse", "HEAD^{tree}"], text=True).strip() == root_sha
        assert (primary / "bin" / "run.sh").stat().st_mode & 0o111
        assert os.path.islink(primary / "links" / "readme")


def test_corrupt_blob() -> None:
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        base = Path(tmp)
        manifest, blobs, _ = make_fixture(base, [("README.md", "100644", b"fixture\n")])
        blob = next(blobs.iterdir())
        blob.write_bytes(b"corrupt")
        run(importer_args(base, manifest, blobs), False)
        assert not (base / "out" / "primary").exists()


def test_case_collision() -> None:
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        base = Path(tmp)
        manifest, blobs, _ = make_fixture(base, [
            ("Readme.md", "100644", b"A"),
            ("README.md", "100644", b"B"),
        ])
        run(importer_args(base, manifest, blobs), False)


def test_unsafe_path() -> None:
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        base = Path(tmp)
        manifest, blobs, _ = make_fixture(base, [("README.md", "100644", b"A")])
        payload = json.loads(manifest.read_text())
        payload["entries"][-1]["path"] = "../escape"
        manifest.write_text(json.dumps(payload))
        run(importer_args(base, manifest, blobs), False)


def test_unsafe_symlink() -> None:
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        base = Path(tmp)
        manifest, blobs, _ = make_fixture(base, [("links/escape", "120000", b"../../outside")])
        run(importer_args(base, manifest, blobs), False)


def test_submodule() -> None:
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        base = Path(tmp)
        manifest, blobs, _ = make_fixture(base, [("README.md", "100644", b"A")], add_submodule=True)
        run(importer_args(base, manifest, blobs), False)


def test_lfs_pointer() -> None:
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        base = Path(tmp)
        manifest, blobs, _ = make_fixture(base, [("assets/lfs.bin", "100644", b"ignored")], lfs_pointer=True)
        run(importer_args(base, manifest, blobs), False)


def test_wrong_repository() -> None:
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        base = Path(tmp)
        manifest, blobs, _ = make_fixture(base, [("README.md", "100644", b"A")], repository="someone/else")
        run(importer_args(base, manifest, blobs), False)


def main() -> None:
    test_success()
    test_corrupt_blob()
    test_case_collision()
    test_unsafe_path()
    test_unsafe_symlink()
    test_submodule()
    test_lfs_pointer()
    test_wrong_repository()
    print("PASS: exact-snapshot importer verifies blobs and trees, preserves modes and safe symlinks, initializes a clean local repository, and rejects corrupt or unsafe snapshots.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
